```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
library(scales)
output_dir <- file.path("results", "behavior_network")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_plot_bundle <- function(plot, stem, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300) {
  svglite::svglite(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".svg")), width = width, height = height, bg = "transparent")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf")), width = width, height = height, family = "Arial")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  ragg::agg_png(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")), width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}
```

## Load Data
```{r load-data}
load(file.path("..", "..", "data", "data_agg", "post_final.Rdata"))
load(file.path("..", "..", "data", "data_agg", "SNmF_igraph.Rdata"))
```

## Shared Settings
```{r shared-settings}
behavior_vars <- c("BE", "BE_TP", "BEE", "BEE_TP", "donate", "RD", "TG", "TPP")
corruption_vars <- c("BE", "BE_TP", "BEE", "BEE_TP")
filler_vars <- c("donate", "RD", "TG", "TPP")

network_names <- c(
  "Friendship",
  "Daily-activity",
  "Personal life-sharing",
  "Gossip-sharing",
  "Positive-cooperation",
  "Negative-cooperation"
)

network_colors <- setNames(
  c("#C77CFF", "#4DA6FF", "#F8766D", "#FFB74D", "#66BB6A", "#9E9E9E"),
  network_names
)
```

## Prepare Behavioral Data
```{r behavior-data}
if (nrow(post_final) != 113L) {
  stop("post_final must contain 113 complete participants.")
}

behavior_data <- post_final %>%
  select(node_id, all_of(behavior_vars))

behavior_long <- behavior_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(behavior_vars),
    names_to = "behavior",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type = if_else(behavior %in% corruption_vars, "Corruption", "Filler"),
    behavior = factor(behavior, levels = behavior_vars)
  )
```

## Behavioral Descriptive Statistics
```{r behavior-descriptive-statistics}
descriptive_stats <- behavior_long %>%
  group_by(behavior, type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    M = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(M, SD, Median, IQR, Min, Max), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )

descriptive_stats
```

## Prepare Behavioral Plot Data
```{r behavior-plot-data}
corruption_long <- behavior_long %>%
  filter(type == "Corruption") %>%
  mutate(
    behavior = factor(
      behavior,
      levels = corruption_vars,
      labels = c("a", " b", " c", " d")
    )
  )

filler_long <- behavior_long %>%
  filter(type == "Filler") %>%
  mutate(
    behavior = factor(
      behavior,
      levels = filler_vars,
      labels = c(" a", " b", " c", " d")
    )
  )
```

## Behavioral Plotting Function
```{r behavior-plot-function}
make_violin_plot <- function(data, violin_fill, box_fill, point_color) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = behavior, y = score)) +
    geom_violin(
      trim = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.5,
      color = NA,
      fill = violin_fill,
      width = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.16,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.85,
      color = "grey40",
      fill = box_fill
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.10,
      alpha = 0.45,
      size = 2.4,
      shape = 16,
      color = point_color
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = ""
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1 / 20) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      aspect.ratio = 1
    )
}
```

## Prepare Network Data
```{r network-data}
graph_list <- setNames(
  list(
    SNmF_igraph[[1]],
    SNmF_igraph[[2]],
    SNmF_igraph[[3]],
    SNmF_igraph[[4]],
    SNmF_igraph[[5]],
    SNmF_igraph[[6]]
  ),
  network_names
)
```

## Construct the Shared Network
```{r network-shared-layout}
all_nodes <- V(graph_list[[1]])$name

union_graph <- make_empty_graph(n = length(all_nodes), directed = TRUE)
V(union_graph)$name <- all_nodes

for (graph in graph_list) {
  edge_list <- as_edgelist(graph, names = TRUE)
  if (nrow(edge_list) > 0) {
    union_graph <- add_edges(union_graph, t(edge_list))
  }
}

union_graph <- simplify(union_graph, remove.multiple = TRUE, remove.loops = TRUE)
```

## Network Layout Function
```{r network-layout-function}
resolve_overlaps <- function(pos, min_dist = 0.06, iter = 300, move_frac = 0.6) {
  n <- nrow(pos)
  for (it in seq_len(iter)) {
    distance_matrix <- as.matrix(stats::dist(pos))
    distance_matrix[lower.tri(distance_matrix, diag = TRUE)] <- Inf
    nearby_pairs <- which(distance_matrix < min_dist, arr.ind = TRUE)
    if (nrow(nearby_pairs) == 0) break
    for (k in seq_len(nrow(nearby_pairs))) {
      i <- nearby_pairs[k, 1]
      j <- nearby_pairs[k, 2]
      delta <- pos[i, ] - pos[j, ]
      distance <- sqrt(sum(delta^2))
      if (distance == 0) {
        delta <- runif(2, -0.01, 0.01)
        distance <- sqrt(sum(delta^2))
      }
      shift <- ((min_dist - distance) / 2) * (delta / distance)
      pos[i, ] <- pos[i, ] + shift * move_frac
      pos[j, ] <- pos[j, ] - shift * move_frac
    }
  }
  pos
}
```

## Compute the Shared Layout
```{r network-layout}
set.seed(1234)
shared_layout <- layout_with_fr(
  union_graph,
  niter = 2000,
  area = vcount(union_graph)^2 * 8,
  repulserad = vcount(union_graph)^2 * 8
)
shared_layout[, 1] <- shared_layout[, 1] * 1.5

shared_layout <- resolve_overlaps(shared_layout, min_dist = 0.06, iter = 300, move_frac = 0.6)
shared_layout <- norm_coords(shared_layout, xmin = -1.2, xmax = 1.2, ymin = -0.9, ymax = 0.9)
rownames(shared_layout) <- V(union_graph)$name
```

## In-degree Range
```{r network-indegree-range}
all_indegree <- unlist(lapply(graph_list, function(graph) degree(graph, mode = "in")))
global_indegree_range <- range(all_indegree)

global_indegree_range
```

## Network Plotting Function
```{r network-plot-function}
plot_network_file <- function(network_index, filename, device = c("svg", "pdf", "png"), dpi = 300) {
  device <- match.arg(device)
  if (device == "svg") svglite::svglite(filename, width = 12, height = 12, bg = "transparent")
  if (device == "pdf") grDevices::cairo_pdf(filename, width = 12, height = 12, family = "Arial")
  if (device == "png") ragg::agg_png(filename, width = 12, height = 12, units = "in", res = dpi)
  on.exit(dev.off(), add = TRUE)

  network_name <- names(graph_list)[network_index]
  graph <- graph_list[[network_index]]
  plot_layout <- shared_layout[V(graph)$name, , drop = FALSE]
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1), bg = NA, family = "Arial")
  layout(1)

  plot_layout[, 1] <- plot_layout[, 1] * 0.8
  plot_layout[, 2] <- plot_layout[, 2] * 0.8

  indegree <- degree(graph, mode = "in")
  vertex_size <- scales::rescale(indegree, to = c(3, 10), from = global_indegree_range)

  plot(
    graph,
    layout = plot_layout,
    rescale = FALSE,
    xlim = range(plot_layout[, 1]),
    ylim = range(plot_layout[, 2]),
    margin = -0.3,
    vertex.size = vertex_size,
    vertex.color = scales::alpha(network_colors[network_name], 0.88),
    vertex.frame.color = NA,
    vertex.label = NA,
    edge.color = scales::alpha("grey40", 0.45),
    edge.arrow.size = 0.10,
    edge.width = 2,
    edge.curved = 0.02,
    main = ""
  )
}
```

## Export Network Plot
```{r export-network-plot}

plot_network_file(1, file.path(output_dir, "network_1.pdf"), "pdf")
```
